judgment.wording: An agent that wants a line in the psyche submits it through the regular interface, and a judgment is run on the submission before anything changes. The judgment asks whether the line is already said somewhere in the psyche, the same or nearly; whether it is going into the wrong module; and whether the module it is going into is inadequately named.
